secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Required for the Ask (اسأل) screen to call Claude. Get it from the Anthropic Console → API Keys. The app boots without it; only the assistant chat returns an error.

secrets.name: LOYVERSE_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional. Connects a real Loyverse POS so the dashboard shows live sales. Without it the app runs on labelled demo data.

secrets.name: FEEDBACK_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Where 'not helpful' reports and support tickets are delivered (e.g. a Slack/Discord webhook).
